check_box.label: Enable Cinematic Camera
check_box.name: CinematicCamEnabled
check_box.tool_tip: Takes over the camera. Uncheck to return to the normal camera.

check_box.label: Target selected avatar
check_box.name: CinematicCamUseSelected
check_box.tool_tip: Follow the selected avatar instead of yourself (falls back to you if nothing valid is selected)

check_box.label: Frame head
check_box.name: CinematicCamLookAtHead
check_box.tool_tip: Patterns aim at the head joint instead of chest height

check_box.label: Handheld operator
check_box.name: CinematicCamUseOperator
check_box.tool_tip: Route the cinematic camera through the procedural handheld operator for organic texture

spinner.label: Dutch
spinner.name: CinematicCamDutchAngle
spinner.tool_tip: Dutch (tilt) angle in deg, applied to every mode. 0 = level

slider.label: Smooth (s)
slider.name: CinematicCamSmoothing
slider.tool_tip: Temporal smoothing in seconds. 0 = rigid lock (true GoPro), higher = steadicam glide

spinner.label: Frame Up
spinner.name: CinematicCamFrameOffsetUp
spinner.tool_tip: Raise/lower the framing point (m) for every target-framing mode. Not applied in Bone Lock (use its mount offsets)

combo_box.name: preset_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Named rig presets (all modes' settings). Selecting one applies it.

button.label: Save
button.name: btn_preset_save
button.tool_tip: Save the complete current rig state (every mode's settings) as a named preset

button.label: Del
button.name: btn_preset_delete
button.tool_tip: Delete the selected preset from disk

button.label: Reset Mode
button.name: btn_reset_mode
button.tool_tip: Reset the current mode's parameters to their defaults

button.label: Reset All
button.name: btn_reset_all
button.tool_tip: Reset the shared settings and every mode's parameters to their defaults

combo_box.name: CinematicCamJoint
combo_box.tool_tip: Skeleton joint to mount the camera on (type any joint name, including Bento bones)

check_box.label: Level horizon
check_box.name: CinematicCamBoneHorizonLock
check_box.tool_tip: Keep the horizon level (gimbal) instead of rolling with the bone

spinner.label: Fwd
spinner.name: CinematicCamBoneOffsetForward
spinner.tool_tip: Mount offset forward of the joint (m)

spinner.label: Left
spinner.name: CinematicCamBoneOffsetLeft
spinner.tool_tip: Mount offset left of the joint (m)

spinner.label: Bob
spinner.name: CinematicCamOrbitBob
spinner.tool_tip: Vertical bob amplitude while orbiting (m); 0 = flat

check_box.label: Ping-pong
check_box.name: CinematicCamSweepPingPong
check_box.tool_tip: Reverse at the ends instead of jumping back to the start

spinner.label: Heading
spinner.name: CinematicCamVertigoHeading
spinner.tool_tip: Bearing relative to the subject's facing (deg)

spinner.label: Ht
spinner.name: CinematicCamVertigoHeight
spinner.tool_tip: Height relative to the focus point (m)

combo_box.name: CinematicCamVertigoEndMode

spinner.label: Heading

spinner.label: Out
